name: WP3 matched-quality simulation efficiency
authorization: User: 进行WP3; report and stop before WP4
registration: Prospective private artifact lock, not a public registry or certified timestamp

hypotheses.primary: Graphical coupling requires fewer physical trajectories and less measured serial wall time to attain the same fixed selection-quality target than each prespecified baseline
hypotheses.ablation: With greedy logic and budget unchanged, graphical coupling changes deployed loss relative to thinning and common reaction paths; no automatic claim of improvement
hypotheses.no_gate_rescue: Variance reduction alone cannot pass the selection-efficiency gate

graphs.construction: Identical topology laws and independent node-label permutation to WP2; fresh root and all fresh topologies
graphs.replacement: None; all families and cells reported; no graph omission or outcome-based restart

cell_scope: Two opposite corners of the prespecified WP2 grid, selected for mechanism coverage; no cell screening, eligibility calibration, or cellwise claim rescue in WP3
normalization: beta1=1.15/(mean_degree*trust), beta2=3*beta2_scale/(mean_face_participation*trust); zero when denominator zero; u=3

histories.law: Independent U/R/C probabilities [.6,.2,.2], zero face memory; exact thinning prehistory at target0,u1.5,D.6,H2.4
histories.acceptance: At least one R and one C at endpoint; all attempts retained; failure aborts without graph replacement

seeds.histories: Initial phase10, process phase11, indexed by graph,cell,attempt
seeds.benchmark: phase200,trial; same tape IDs across actions, modes use their own prescribed construction
seeds.ablation_final: phase500; disjoint from every selection and reference phase

benchmark.portfolio: R-degree k-set + top2 one-swap proposals + top1 two-swap proposal from unchanged face-exchange proxy. If no face pair, generic pair fallback; if absent, more distinct one-swaps. No simulations in construction.
benchmark.non_nested: All four sets have the same k and are distinct; no pair is a subset of another
benchmark.selection: Sample-mean argmin, index tie break, first index is deterministic R-degree anchor; no racing or extra safety gate
benchmark.prefixes: Same repetitions reused as prefixes at larger budgets; not independent experiments; graph cluster bootstrap retains this dependence
benchmark.antithetic: Thinning using every uniform U on one tape and every 1-U on its mate; evaluate both paths. Store interleaved complete pairs in each even increment. Only half the supplied IDs generate independent tapes. No assumption that variance must improve.
benchmark.timing: Sum measured incremental perf_counter engine calls plus sample-mean argmin, per trial and method; randomized method order per trial; all four sets evaluated serially inside each worker. CPU time also recorded.
benchmark.timing_limit: 8 concurrent workers with 8-CPU quota; timings are measured shared-host serial workloads, not hardware-independent benchmarks; no compilation/history/reference cost in online per-query curves

reference.rule: A chooses minimum among fixed four candidates; independent bank B estimates each deployed selection minus this frozen A reference. Never use min(B) as the primary baseline.
reference.limitation: Reference is an approximate finite-portfolio comparator, not a certified global optimum. B argmin agreement and apparent gaps are diagnostics, not selection filters or new primaries.

quality.estimand: Mean extra cumulative rumor burden relative to independent bank-A reference, estimated without clipping from independent bank B; may be negative
quality.crossing: Smallest observed budget at which mean extra loss and ALL subsequent observed budget means are <=epsilon; no interpolation or isotonic smoothing
quality.censoring: If baseline never crosses, its max observed cost is a conservative lower bound on required cost on the tested grid; label ratio as lower bound. If graphical never crosses, no efficiency claim; bootstrap ratio lower bound set to0.
quality.max_budget_check: Graphical mean at maximum budget must have descriptive pointwise95% upper bound<=epsilon to pass the gate
quality.zero_simulation_check: Report deterministic R-degree anchor extra loss with pointwise95% interval. Its lower bound must exceed epsilon for the gate: if zero simulations may already attain target, do not claim savings for requiring simulations.

nested.sets: R-degree k-set and its first k-1 sorted nodes
nested.role: Separate variance control only, excluded from selection gate

ablation.search: Unchanged node greedy from WP2, pool16, same seed coordinates/remainder rule. Coupling mode is the only search component varied; u,D,k and budget identical.
ablation.final: Distinct chosen k-sets and R-degree, common new graphical tapes. Not a four-set portfolio regret estimate.
ablation.reason: Isolate engine effect without mixing in face proposals, surrogate changes, or a weaker post hoc baseline

statistics.unit: Graph, n=32; equal average of2cells x3histories x4selection trials where applicable; equal family weights
statistics.resampling: Stratified within four graph families, keep all contexts/methods/budgets of each sampled graph; percentile intervals
statistics.main_family: 6 cost-to-quality ratios (3 baselines x physical paths/wall time) +2 ablation deployed-loss contrasts; Bonferroni two-sided alpha=.05/8 =>99.375% intervals
statistics.gate: All six conservative cost-ratio adjusted lower bounds>1; graphical maximum-budget extra-loss pointwise95% upper<=.02; zero-simulation anchor extra-loss pointwise95% lower>.02; neither ablation adjusted interval lies entirely below0 (reliable harm). If any fail, WP3 gate fails. Secondary variance results cannot rescue it.
statistics.curves: Pointwise95% descriptive bands for all curves, all families and both cells retained; no new gate defined from these bands
statistics.variance: All six equal-size non-nested pairs and one nested pair. Antithetic effective per-physical-path variance=2*variance(pair-averaged paired-action differences). Other modes use ordinary variance. Report zero variances, infinite-ratio counts, finite-positive medians and ratios of mean variances.
statistics.cost_ratio_bootstrap: Resample whole graphs and recompute stable threshold crossings; censored-control numerator=max observed cost yields a conservative lower bound; censored-graphical draw yields0. Report censor counts and step-grid uncertainty. Nominal bootstrap coverage, no finite-sample exact guarantee.
statistics.no_stopping: Fixed sample sizes, no interim effect inspection, no adaptive grid extension or endpoint substitution
statistics.sign_counts: Graph-level gain >1e-12 / <-1e-12 / otherwise tie, wherever a signed effect is meaningful

fairness.absorption: All three loss-only engines stop when rumor count becomes zero; no R donor means rumor cannot reappear. Full history calls still simulate endpoint state/memory. Early-stop optimization itself is not credited to coupling.
fairness.old_engine: Original six-transition-channel RTC implementation retained apart from the exact loss-only absorption stop; no deliberately inefficient added work
fairness.compile: g++ -O3 -std=c++17 -shared -fPIC, all engines on same host
fairness.not_claimed: No novelty of graphical constructions, common reaction paths or antithetic variates in general; no global-optimality, submodularity or universal non-nested variance guarantee

execution.checkpoints: Atomic complete context; exact protocol/source hashes. Reuse complete matching context only; operational partial restarts must preserve earlier artifacts and report extra work.
execution.failures: Any invalid loss, event cap, corrupt output or exhausted history acceptance stops, not omits. Any scientific fix after cohort outcomes requires disclosed new lock/cohort.
execution.raw: All reference/benchmark/nested/ablation losses, action IDs, seeds, order randomization, timings, event counts where available, rejected histories, code and hash manifest. RTC proposals diagnostic column is unavailable (stored placeholder0), not a measured proposal count.
execution.budget_rationale: 32 balanced graph clusters, 3 histories per cell and4 selection trials chosen under fixed <=6.49million continuation cap using validation-only throughput; not outcome-based power. Step-grid cost ratios and family intervals can be imprecise; no post hoc expansion.

decision: Report WP3 and wait for user. WP2 pass plus WP3 pass permits considering A+B in restricted tested scope, not FCS readiness. WP3 failure must retain both its negative result and WP2 conditional positive result.
